reviewer: independent binder_review agent; no producer/auditor/queue/status edits

plain_language.what_did_we_find: Provisional: the resource study has begun preparation for two families at six sizes on two checkers. No new selected terms, checker setup or scientific measurements exist yet. Prior accepted cases provide reuse leads but are not matched resource baselines.
plain_language.is_it_interesting: Potentially. A fixed, valid workload and explicit startup and memory measurements could provide a reusable operational regression. Its value remains untested until the validity and measurement gates pass.
plain_language.does_it_require_more_work: Yes. Establish exact families and sizes, independent validity and input audits, comparable checker settings, measurement definitions and failure controls; freeze and commit them under independent review before construction or launch.

findings.authority: Queue schema-v4 ENTRY selects only RESOURCE-ENVELOPE-PILOT-1 ACTIVE, with zero READY items. Live status, frontier and item plan now agree; fixed scientific scope remains two families by six sizes by two observers.
findings.strategic_review: All five required categories are present with exact evidence bindings and a feasible local preparation path. Build-mode remains the planned alternative; upstream holds and external-input transfer limits are unchanged. No assurance milestone transition or external action is authorized.
findings.historical_preservation: The entire Attempted section is byte-identical to the pre-entry committed text. Prior binder and real-proof findings remain unchanged. Their earlier checking outcomes are correctly retained as checking evidence, not mislabelled parse-only measurements.
findings.construction_gate: Entry grants only source/reuse, validity and measurement-control preparation. Selected terms, observer setup/build and launches remain prohibited until exact reviewed committed scientific/execution inputs and stage-specific gates. Pre-freeze tests must use disjoint synthetic fixtures, not selected records.
findings.validity_gate: Require independently derived typing for both families and all six sizes before freeze, followed by an independent audit of every exact generated input and its observer encoding before launch. Prior positive cases and oversize cases cannot substitute for this evidence.
findings.comparability_gate: Require identical intended checking task and encoded input bytes, explicit thread/configuration and completion semantics, plus a preregistered baseline design. Empty-input timing does not isolate size-dependent parsing, and peak RSS values must not be naively subtracted.
findings.measurement_gate: Define serialized bytes, unique graph nodes, expanded-tree size and depth; wall-time boundaries; wrapper/startup/import overhead; per-process versus process-group RSS; sample cadence and missed peaks; platform-specific peak-RSS units; timeout attribution and cleanup. Historical runner samples the waiting wrapper before exec, so it alone does not establish observer memory.
findings.safety_and_limits: Actual-host positive RSS and negative-capable timeout, monitor, accounting and cleanup controls remain required before launch. Safely enforced preregistered per-cell limits need diagnosed attribution and remaining-cell dispositions; monitoring/accounting/cleanup failures require same-item repair, not scientific closure.
findings.remaining: Source/API and protocol review, producer/auditor independence and negative tests, exact manifest freeze and input generation/launch reviews remain unpassed. This entry verdict does not grant those gates.
